title: The Quiet Regiment
author: Astrid Hartwell
blurb: Wendell Crane, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
